sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Bạn có thể kiểm tra địa chỉ này trong ứng dụng không?

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the app screen before you ask. It lets the other person check the address without guessing what you mean.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: What is the Wi-Fi password?; Do you sell SIM cards?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best in a SIM shop, hotel desk, or cafe counter, before the explanation gets long. Keep the phone screen, error message, charger, or map app close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: This phrase can sound warm when the request is small and your tone is calm. A visible phone screen, receipt, or booking helps the other person answer without a long explanation.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: My phone battery is dead, Do you have a charger, and Can I charge my phone here.
